> Blog · Prestige · 2026-08-01

# Brief
- Title: Sewer Line Maintenance: How to Keep a Lowcountry Line from Backing Up
- Slug: /blog/sewer-line-maintenance/. Role: Support 6. Intent: informational (TOFU). About 1,040 words.
- Primary keyword: sewer line maintenance. Secondaries: how to prevent sewer backup, sewer line cleaning schedule, sewer maintenance tips, root treatment for sewer line, sewer line maintenance Bluffton SC.

# Angle
Most backups are preventable with ordinary habits plus scheduled cleaning and camera checks. Sections cover why maintenance matters more here (live oak roots, hurricane-season rain, older clay and cast iron laterals), keeping grease and wipes out, staying ahead of roots, cleaning and camera before failure, checking the backwater valve, a pre-hurricane-season checklist, and an FAQ.

# Flag status
- Links to nearly every cluster post (pillar, backflow, trenchless, rain, camera, hydro-jetting), so it must publish LAST.
- First-hand proof is optional (Matt's recommended local maintenance interval).
- Gated for Scott: cleaning, inspection and maintenance-plan pricing, free language, warranties.

# Status
Drip Day 12 (scheduled 2026-08-13), followed by the cluster-wide go-index step. Not yet published per the cluster list.
